name: moonwitness-xv
description: Moonwitness - modular TypeScript Fastify monorepo with OpenAPI, a plugin system, and a WhatsApp (Baileys) plugin

scripts.build: pnpm build:libs && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/arsy build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/aigateway build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/sentinel build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/cockpit build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/skylink build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/echolog build
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/headquarters build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/dock build && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/orbit build
scripts.clean: node -e "const{rmSync,readdirSync,statSync}=require('fs');const{join}=require('path');const walk=(d)=>{for(const e of readdirSync(d)){if(e==='node_modules'||e==='.git')continue;const p=join(d,e);const s=statSync(p);if(s.isDirectory()){if(e==='dist'||e==='.next'){rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});continue}walk(p)}else if(e.endsWith('.tsbuildinfo'))rmSync(p,{force:true})}};walk('.')/* also wipe the root-level buildinfo files */"
scripts.verify:docker: docker build -t moonwitness . && docker build -f Dockerfile.web --build-arg APP=dock --build-arg APP_PORT=3001 -t moonwitness-dock . && docker build -f Dockerfile.web --build-arg APP=headquarters --build-arg APP_PORT=3002 -t moonwitness-headquarters .
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @moonwitness/core test && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/dock test && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/arsy test && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/arsy exec tsx --test ../../apps/headquarters/test/session-auth.test.ts ../../apps/headquarters/test/login-locale.test.ts ../../apps/headquarters/test/shell-locale.test.ts ../../apps/headquarters/test/hq-authz-guard.test.ts ../../apps/headquarters/test/locale-preference.test.ts ../../apps/headquarters/test/hq-locale-regression.test.ts ../../apps/headquarters/test/editor-actions.test.ts ../../apps/headquarters/test/shadow-editor.test.ts && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/arsy exec node --test ../../apps/headquarters/test/hq-locale-e2e.spec.mjs && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/aigateway test && pnpm exec node --test test/planning/m21-02-ai-candidate-evidence.test.mjs test/planning/m33-05-private-poster-access-attribution.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/skylink test && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/sentinel test && pnpm exec node --test test/app-factory/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/echolog test && pnpm --filter @moonwitness/orbit test
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm ui:check && pnpm lint && pnpm gen:sdk:check && pnpm test && pnpm build:web
